raw_response:
This small piece of land I have for beans, I intercrop it with my maize like my father taught me. I am an old man now, 55, and I have never been to school, but I know beans do not need the white fertilizer like maize does — they take their strength from the soil themselves. I will put some manure from my goats if I have enough, and plant the seeds I saved from last harvest. My wife and children will help me weed; we do not have money to pay people for such a small piece.
